title.narrative: EEF - Civic Engagement for Democratic Governance and Social Cohesion

description.narrative: The action aims to strengthen the role of Moldovan civil society in promoting inclusive, participatory governance and social cohesion in the context of EU accession. Anchored in human rights and gender equality, the project supports over 300 CSOs and networks across Moldova’s five development regions, including Gagauzia and the Transnistrian region. It has three main objectives: (1) empower over five CSO platforms representing vulnerable groups (persons with disabilities, Roma, youth, older people, gender equality), bringing together over 200 CSOs, to engage in evidence-based, inclusive policy advocacy; (2) enable at least 100 local CSOs and their constituents to participate in community mobilization and policy dialogue through tailored training, sub-grants, and technical assistance; (3) foster crossregional partnerships between CSOs to build trust, replicate good practices, and promote social cohesion. Activities include advocacy and organisational capacity building, facilitating development of joint advocacy rooted in international human rights standards and commitments, strategic sub-granting, support to democratic innovations such as Civic Participation Councils, multilevel policy dialogue, learning exchanges, joint opinions, cross-regional partnerships. The project takes a holistic, multi-level approach to strengthening civic engagement, addressing both immediate capacity gaps and longer-term structural challenges to ensure that CSOs act as key drivers of democratic transformation and inclusive development in Moldova.
